best_section.where: the gravel car park loop beside the oval, by the tennis courts off Hughes Lane

summary: Gravel sports-ground car park, screened by trees and an open oval, with other vehicles already parked there.
reasons: Open oval and tennis courts, no houses visible nearby
Gravel loop with room to turn, vehicles already parked

drivers.seclusion: No house fronts or windows visible within the 160 m frame; bordered by open oval to the north, tennis courts and a treeline to the south, and a clubhouse building roughly 30-40 m to the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel/dirt car park loop off a park access lane, wide enough for a light van with space to turn; no gate or barrier visible across the entrance.
drivers.traffic: Looks like a quiet dead-end park road serving the oval and tennis club, not a through route.
drivers.convention: Several cars, a trailer and what looks like a boat already parked in the same area in the QLD imagery, so a van wouldn't stand out.

flags: Gentle slope only (around 1.4% mean, up to 4.4%), not steep
Sports club car park: could see evening training, matches or lock-up outside imagery
Clubhouse building with lights/solar panels nearby to the east
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky over the oval to the north; a treeline along the south/west edge of the car park gives some afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park has a gate that's locked at night (none visible, but common at sports grounds)
Evening activity, lighting or noise from the oval/tennis club/clubhouse
Surface firmness of the gravel area in wet weather
